in_marathi.name: Arvind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arvind हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arvind is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arvindam’, meaning ‘with dark complexion and brave’. In Hindu mythology, Arvind is considered a form of Lord Indra, the god of rain, thunder, and lightning. This name is also associated with the brave warrior Arjuna in the Hindu epic Mahabharata.
